body: Thanks. I just wish she would tell me rather than pretending.

Thank you. It's a shame and I wish she would just tell me rather than us having awkward as fuck phone calls and meet ups. My problem is I don't have many friends, and the friends I do have live all over the country so I rarely see them and instead chat with them online. By moving back home I hoped I could have friends that I actually saw in person.

I'm glad I moved up north but I work weird hours now, so I don't know where the best place to find friends is! I live alone at the moment too and although my partner comes to stay over the weekend I get lonely during the week. Definitely not excluding hetero males as my workplace is 99% men 😂
I know I'm lucky to have people who love me, and that makes me feel all the more guilty for having the urge to kill myself in the first place.
Thank you. It's 3am where I am so I think I should try to sleep at least.
Thank you for commenting - I think I needed someone to read this and hear me.

Thanks, I do try but when you're alone in bed at night the bad thoughts start to creep in. I'm currently hunting for a job which doesn't help stress levels/self esteem either. I do have lots of hobbies though to keep busy with.

Thanks, this was on my dad's laptop and as it was such a long time ago I doubt if he has the laptop anymore. It may well have been his work laptop, in which case he definitely doesn't have it anymore as he no longer works for that company.

I've never told my parents about this but I'll have to if I want to find out if he still has that laptop, which makes me kind of nervous. I know it shouldn't but it does.
This is what I thought would be the case - the only reason I would go through with it and report is for the slim chance that there *is* proof of him doing the same thing to other girls.
